name: mateDespiteMaterialDeficit
description: Finds checkmates delivered despite a material deficit of 8 points or more.
query:
cql()
flipcolor {
  player white "Alexander2magnus"
  btm
  mate
  power a - power A >= 8
  comment "Checkmate despite material deficit"
}
